_note: Picture slots: where a generated picture is inserted. 'seed' [x, y] flood-fills the blank area from that point (exact mask for curved/irregular blanks); 'rect' [x, y, w, h] is a plain box for areas that are not one flat colour. 'corners': true warps the picture onto the blank's four corners (a sheet of paper held at an angle, seen in perspective). Fractions of the template image. build_meme_catalog.py writes masks to memes/masks/.
